::: {.about-feature-card}
## About Me

I am a Data Analytics Engineering graduate student at George Mason University with a background in Computer Science, Business Administration, and HR Operations. My experience combines technical analytics, business process understanding, and people-centered leadership.

I am interested in building practical analytics solutions that support decision-making in areas such as AI-driven data analysis, machine learning, fraud analytics, KYC/AML compliance, business intelligence, and risk scoring. I enjoy working with data from raw preparation to final insights, including cleaning, modeling, visualization, and communicating results clearly.
:::
